prompt: What does least privilege ask of an agent's tools?

choices.text: The smallest set, with the smallest access, that does the job
choices.why: Right. What it is able to do, kept small.

choices.text: Every tool the business has, so the agent is never stuck
choices.why: That is the opposite.

choices.text: Tools that only read
choices.why: The refunds agent needs one that writes; the rule is about need, not kind.

choices.text: A confirmation before each one
choices.why: Confirmation is a separate layer, and asking everywhere weakens it.

prompt: Why is 'nothing' never the answer to 'what could the agent be led to ask for?'

choices.text: Because models always disobey their instructions
choices.why: Nothing says always; the point is that it cannot be ruled out.

choices.text: It reads text it did not write, and some of that text holds instructions
choices.why: Right. So what it is able to do has to be small enough to live with.

choices.text: Because tool descriptions are encrypted
choices.why: They are plain text the model reads.

choices.text: Because the host forwards every message to every server
choices.why: Servers see only their calls (lesson 12).

prompt: How does internal/audit make it impossible to write an entry without an actor?

choices.text: By checking for an actor at the end of each day
choices.why: The check is in the type, at the moment of writing.

choices.text: By asking the database to fill in a default
choices.why: A default would be an absent actor with a name.

choices.text: By deleting entries that have none
choices.why: The audit is append-only; nothing is deleted.

choices.text: Only two constructors build an Actor
choices.why: Right. Its fields are unexported, so Staff or System is the only way: there is no way to name nobody.

prompt: Why does a Staff actor copy the person's name in rather than join it later?

choices.text: Because names are shorter than ids
choices.why: Length is not the reason.

choices.text: Because the database cannot join tables
choices.why: It can; the point is what a join would return later.

choices.text: People are renamed and leave
choices.why: Right. The entry must stay readable: 'actor 9f2c…' a year later is not an answer.

choices.text: Because staff ids are secret, so the audit is not allowed to store them
choices.why: The id is stored too, beside the label.

prompt: When the support agent's model asked for refunds__refund, what stopped the refund?

choices.text: A person who declined
choices.why: Nobody was asked.

choices.text: The refunds server's token check
choices.why: The refunds server was not running for this role.

choices.text: The role's list
choices.why: Right. The tool was not on the support role's list, so the host refused it before any server was involved.

choices.text: The model changed its mind
choices.why: It asked; the host refused.

prompt: Why does role_host.py not even start the refunds server for the support role?

choices.text: A stopped server is never reached by mistake
choices.why: Right. Least privilege applies to processes as well as tools.

choices.text: Because two servers cannot run at once
choices.why: The refunds role runs two.

choices.text: To save memory, since the refunds server loads the embedding model at start-up
choices.why: It does not; the reason is access, not memory.

choices.text: Because the refunds server refuses support agents
choices.why: It is never asked.

prompt: Why does the host's question show the order, the amount and the reason?

choices.text: Because the server requires them in the question
choices.why: The host writes its own question.

choices.text: So the person approves this call, not a category of calls
choices.why: Right. 'Allow the refund tool?' gets a yes every time.

choices.text: Because the model asked it to
choices.why: The model does not write the host's questions.

choices.text: To fill the audit file, which needs at least three fields per line to be valid
choices.why: The audit is written separately.

prompt: What goes wrong when a host asks a person before every call, reads included?

choices.text: Nothing; more questions are always safer
choices.why: Too many questions stop being read.

choices.text: The model refuses to work, because it cannot wait for a person more than once per run
choices.why: The model is not affected.

choices.text: The protocol forbids it
choices.why: MCP says nothing about how often a host asks.

choices.text: People learn to press y, and the question that matters is answered like the rest
choices.why: Right. Ask where the answer matters.

prompt: What is the canary in the test article for?

choices.text: To show text steering the reply
choices.why: Right. If the marker reaches the reply, text the agent read steered what it wrote.

choices.text: To make the article easier to find in search results
choices.why: It has nothing to do with search.

choices.text: To break the model
choices.why: It is harmless by design.

choices.text: To check the help centre's spelling
choices.why: It is a test marker, not content.

prompt: Why is the canary a word to repeat, rather than a request to call a tool?

choices.text: Because the stand-in cannot call tools
choices.why: It calls tools in every lesson.

choices.text: So that a real model that followed it would do nothing in anyone's name
choices.why: Right. A test of a system that acts must itself be harmless.

choices.text: Because tool calls cannot be detected
choices.why: The audit records every call.

choices.text: Because the support role has no tools at all, only read_help
choices.why: It has get_order and search_help too.

prompt: What did the host do when the reply contained PINEAPPLE?

choices.text: Sent it with the word removed
choices.why: It sent nothing.

choices.text: Asked the model to try again
choices.why: No retry was made.

choices.text: Held it back
choices.why: Right. And wrote the held text to the audit: a check with a right answer, in code.

choices.text: Deleted the article
choices.why: The article stayed; the reply was held.

prompt: Which of these did the role audit record? Choose every one that applies.

choices.text: The actor of each decision
choices.why: Right. agent:support or agent:refunds.

choices.text: The refused refund, with its reason
choices.why: Right. not offered.

choices.text: The held reply's text
choices.why: Right.

choices.text: The model's hidden reasoning
choices.why: No such thing was recorded.

prompt: Put the layers a refund request met in this lesson in order, from the model outwards.
Match each question to the layer in this lesson that answers it.

pairs.left: What did it do, and who decided?
